question: Where is crate C-7 at T6 (value_at on located-at, key located, value place); does 'C-7 is at Dock A' hold at T6; and where is C-7 at T3?
justification: s1: at T6 la (system, from T2) and lb (yard-clerk, accepted by the system, from T4) both hold and give two different value players (dock-a, bay-3) to one key (located=c-7) of the declared functional location slot, so value_at reports DISPUTED with every value in the dispute (value_at judgement: 'DISPUTED arises when two holding contents give different value players to one constraint key'; multiplicity: 'every value in a dispute'; §0.12 no disputed content reported as undisputed). lc is unreviewed for the system: it never creates a dispute ('Unreviewed rivals never create a dispute') and is listed in alternatives (unreviewed, not superseded keyed attestation with a verdict at T6, it holds from T5). Evidence roles per P-VA-1 as qualified: in a dispute between several values every value's positive claims are conflicting, so la and lb are conflicting in s1 and nothing is supporting there. s2: the same declared-slot conflict makes the content located-at(c-7, dock-a) DISPUTED for holds (holds DISPUTED: 'a declared-slot conflict'); holds is None when DISPUTED; its own claim la is in support and is supporting, and the rival bay-3 content's deciding claim lb is conflicting (§0.4 [E]: a DISPUTED holds answer rests on its own claims, the rivals and the constraint; P-1 rivals are conflicting). Not INFERRED false by exclusivity: the other value is not established, and 'a disputed slot decides nothing'. s3: at T3 only la holds (lb starts T4, lc starts T5; half-open intervals, SD-CAU-5), so the single value is dock-a, not disputed; la is supporting. la is therefore supporting in s2 and s3 and conflicting in s1 (§0.4 components: one attestation may hold different roles in different plan steps). lc is forbidden as cited evidence in every role (an unreviewed claim; alternatives are never cited).

justification: s1: a same-as question is judged by its stated names and is timeless (holds §1, ID-1, ID-3). The only attestation of same-as(d1, d4) is x14, auditor-r's denial, accepted by the system; there is no assertion of that content, so it is not holding by an accepted denial: holds False, not DISPUTED, and x14 in support is supporting (holds evidence table: 'not holding by an accepted denial'). The links s12, s23, s34 are other contents and are not cited. No unreviewed attestation of the content exists, so alternatives is empty. s2: the established links make {d1, d2, d3, d4} a candidate group, but it contains the denied pair d1=d4, so it is not merged (§0.2, ID-5); d4 is judged without its aliases. Its own claim m4 (system, from T2 until superseded) holds at T2: valid-time intervals are half-open and include their start (SD-CAU-5), so holds True with support [m4], supporting. m1d (harbour-office's denial for d1, accepted by the system, also from T2) is about another name in an unmerged group and is not pooled, so there is no polarity dispute; m2 is about d2 and starts at T3 in any case. Identity links relied on are never added to evidence (holds §4, ID-D §3.10), and here none is relied on. No unreviewed attestation of the content: alternatives empty.
